tweet.text: “Once online, the model attempted to use credentials for online payment processors and to find cryptocurrency to pay for a phone number, which it needed to register an email address. When this failed, it found a free, disposable email provider whose domain PyPI had not blocked, registered an account, published three versions of a malicious package, and used credentials leaked by one of the 15 systems that installed the package to access a real security vendor’s database.”
